label: fall in weekday boardings, 2015 to 2025
detail: Stated on the cover of the 2025 annual report. Dividing 2025 weekday boardings by the 2015 figure in the same report's Table 4 gives 27 percent instead; the report does not say which base year or which definition of a weekday it is using.

sources.title: Annual report 2025 (placeholder)
sources.quote: Weekday boardings have fallen 31 percent over the past decade.
